posts.text: Z.ai is releasing public weights for its new Ox Alpha GLM-series model, expanding the available ecosystem for local inference and fine-tuning. More updates below.
Z.ai published GLM-5.3-Flash, focusing on intelligence and pricing benchmarks for production deployment. https://z.ai/blog/glm-5.3-flash
Qwen announced Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a new architecture optimized for inference cost efficiency. https://qwen.ai/blog?id=qwen3.8-flash-next
Gemini 3.5 Transcribe adds three models to strip filler words and handle 85+ languages. https://deepmind.google/blog/intelligent-transcription-with-gemini-3-5-transcribe
GitHub reported service disruptions affecting repository access and CI/CD pipelines. Monitoring status page for resolution. https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents/hcbtzksccj2f
Full coverage and daily digests: https://airfoil-iota.vercel.app/
